title: Haye Sajjad Kinj Bhulaway Karbal Di Kahani Nu
body:
Kar Kar Ke Yaad Rovay
Akbar Di Jawani Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Syed Beemar Takeya
Akbar Da Seena Zakhmi
Maa Laash Te Na Aayi
Khaimay Ch Rondi Reh Gayi
Shah Chuk Ke Jad Le Aanda
Nanay Di Nishani Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalsoom Te Ruqayya
Enay Rondiyaan Dithiyaan Ne
Beemar Enu Keeta
Sughra Diyaan Chithiyaan Ne
Behnaa De Dard Kha Gaye
Ehdi Shakal Noorani Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Syedaan Da Qafla Ik
Ehde Naal Si Jo Tureya
Karbal Ch Chor Aya
Ehday Naal Naee Oh Mureya
Burqay Baghair Takeya
Enay Zahra E Sani Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Fojaan Ch Vain Kardi
Zainab Nu Vekheya Eh
Shabbir Sar Ba Sajda
Ummat Ne Ghereya Eh
Marda Besheer Takeya
Reya Sikda Jo Pani Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghazi De Lathday Bazu
Qasim Da Sehra Tutda
Sajjad Vekheya Eh
Kubra Da Daaj Lutda
Kisay Rokeya Na Akay
Hy Foj-e-Shetaani Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Quran Zibha Keeta
Hy Shimar Kand Te Char Ke
Mangdi Si Maa Duwavaan
Bachray De Kol Khar Ke
Akhtar Rulaya Ummat
Ayaat-e-Qurani Nu
